Name: Adventurer's Guild Revival
Author: sskerye
Description:
[size=5][b]Adventurer's Guild Revival[/b][/size]
[i]The Adventurer's Guild has been fading for years. With your help, it can become the heart of adventuring in the valley once again.[/i]

[b][size=4]What is this?[/size][/b]
A progression overhaul for the Adventurer's Guild. Instead of a static shop on the mountain, the guild now grows alongside you: the commissions you complete, the regions you explore and survey, and the story moments you experience all feed into the guild's recovery. As the guild revives, its hall is rebuilt, new faces arrive to work there, and new services, commissions and quests open up.

[b][size=4]Current features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Guild progression[/b] — the guild advances through distinct stages of revival, driven by completed work, exploration, investigations and construction. Stages unlock one at a time; materials alone are never enough.[/*]
[*][b]Adventurer rank[/b] — your own standing grows separately, from probationary member to seasoned adventurer, based on the volume and variety of work you do across different days.[/*]
[*][b]Commission boards[/b] — regular and special commissions with full accept / track / deliver / reward / abandon / expiry handling. Material commissions require real deliveries.[/*]
[*][b]Exploration and investigation[/b] — region discovery, field surveys and a monster-slaying ledger all feed guild progress and unlock new content.[/*]
[*][b]Construction projects[/b] — fund and supply multi-day building projects that visibly restore and expand the guild hall, including a full renovation storyline with a temporary reception desk while work is underway.[/*]
[*][b]New guild staff[/b] — new NPCs move in as the guild recovers, each with their own role, dialogue and services.[/*]
[*][b]Guild services and equipment[/b] — whetstone sharpening and armor maintenance at the counter, plus craftable farm machines and a supply station. New item chains include bat guano fertilizer, glow moss lamps, slime transport crates, slime fertilizer, cave compost and a bomb duplicator.[/*]
[*][b]Adventurer's Badge[/b] — joining the guild adds a badge entry to the vanilla "Special Items & Powers" wallet tab.[/*]
[*]Bilingual: English and Chinese (简体中文) text included. Press [b]G[/b] inside the guild to open the guild menu (rebindable in config.json).[/*]
[/list][b][size=4][color=#e69138]Work in progress — please read[/color][/size][/b]
This is an [b]unfinished release[/b]. The revival route currently covers the early-to-mid stages of the guild's recovery, with the opening questlines and events in place. Everything described above is playable, but the journey is not yet complete, and some art is still placeholder. Feedback and bug reports are very welcome at this stage.

[b][size=4]Planned for future updates[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Later guild stages, including rescue operations and follow-up storylines[/*]
[*]Lost-item recovery commissions[/*]
[*]New weapons, boss encounters and a dynamic dungeon[/*]
[*]Supply station buff services and the ore vein detector[/*]
[*]Full multiplayer sync for renovation and decoration[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/*]
[/list]Install like any SMAPI mod: extract into your Mods folder.

[b][size=4]Compatibility & multiplayer[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Single player: fully playable in the current release.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: the host's progression works; farmhands do not yet see renovation and decoration fully synced.[/*]
[*]Compatibility with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b] is not yet verified — guild events and NPC triggers have not been tested alongside SVE. Please report any conflicts.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Feedback[/size][/b]
Balance, pacing and bugs are all being tuned while development continues — comments and reports directly shape what gets built next.

[line]

[size=5][b]探险家公会复兴（Adventurer's Guild Revival）[/b][/size]
[i]探险家公会已经衰落多年。有了你的参与，它可以重新成为山谷冒险者们的核心。[/i]

[b][size=4]这是什么？[/size][/b]
这是一个围绕探险家公会的成长型模组。公会将不再是山顶上一间一成不变的商店，而是会随着你的参与逐步复兴：你完成的委托、探索与调查过的区域、经历的剧情节点，都会转化为公会复兴的进度。随着公会复兴，大厅会被重建，新成员会入驻工作，新的服务、委托与任务也会逐步开放。

[b][size=4]当前功能[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]公会发展阶段[/b] —— 公会按阶段逐步复兴，由完成的工作、探索、调查与建设共同推进。阶段只能逐级解锁，光有材料无法跳级。[/*]
[*][b]冒险者等级[/b] —— 你个人的冒险者身份独立成长，从见习会员一路晋升，依据的是你在不同日子里完成工作的总量与种类。[/*]
[*][b]委托板[/b] —— 常规与特殊委托具备完整的发布、接受、追踪、交付、奖励、放弃与过期处理。材料类委托需要实际交付物品。[/*]
[*][b]探索与调查[/b] —— 区域发现、实地调查与击杀账本都会推进公会进度，并解锁新内容。[/*]
[*][b]建设项目[/b] —— 出资并供料推进跨越多天的建设项目，公会的场地与设施会被真实地修复和扩建，其中包括一段完整的大厅整修剧情，施工期间可在门外的临时接待处办理业务。[/*]
[*][b]公会新成员[/b] —— 随着公会恢复运转，会有新 NPC 入驻，各有自己的职责、对话与服务。[/*]
[*][b]公会服务与装备[/b] —— 柜台提供磨刀石打磨与铠甲保养，另有可制作的农场机器和补给站。新道具链包括蝙蝠粪肥、发光苔藓灯、史莱姆运输箱、史莱姆肥料、洞穴堆肥和炸弹复制机。[/*]
[*][b]冒险者徽章[/b] —— 加入公会后，原版「特殊物品与能力」页签中会增加一枚冒险者徽章条目。[/*]
[*]双语支持：内置英文与简体中文文本。在公会内按 [b]G[/b] 打开公会事务面板（可在 config.json 中改键）。[/*]
[/list][b][size=4][color=#e69138]未完成版本 —— 请务必阅读[/color][/size][/b]
这是一个[b]尚未完成的发布版[/b]。复兴路线目前覆盖公会恢复的前期到中期阶段，开场的任务线与剧情事件已经就位。上述内容都可以正常游玩，但完整的复兴旅程尚未做完，部分美术资源仍是占位图。非常欢迎在这个阶段提出反馈与问题报告。

[b][size=4]后续开发计划[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]更后期的公会阶段，包括救援行动与后续剧情[/*]
[*]遗失物寻回委托[/*]
[*]新武器、Boss 战与动态地牢[/*]
[*]补给站 Buff 服务与矿脉探测器[/*]
[*]装修与布置的完整联机同步[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]运行需求[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]星露谷物语 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 或更高版本[/*]
[/list]安装方式与常规 SMAPI 模组相同：解压到 Mods 文件夹即可。

[b][size=4]兼容与联机[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]单人：当前版本可完整游玩。[/*]
[*]联机：主机进度正常；客机暂时无法完整同步装修与布置。[/*]
[*]与 [b]Stardew Valley Expanded（SVE）[/b] 的兼容性尚未验证 —— 公会事件与 NPC 触发尚未在 SVE 环境下测试。如遇冲突请反馈。[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]反馈[/size][/b]
开发仍在继续，数值平衡、节奏与问题修复都在持续调整 —— 你的评论与报告会直接决定下一步的开发内容。
